title: A Radiators for the Inventory
author: Ansel Galloway
blurb: Gideon Montrose, a piano tuner who hears the house's history in its radiators, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when the last speaker of a language asks for one final student, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must return to the place where the story went wrong before the house sale closes.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
